definition: Close once the position has given back more than giveback of its best value since entry: the best close starts at the entry price, and the exit holds while |best - close| / best is above giveback.
boundaries: With one position of fixed size LEAN's drawdown of absolute holdings value is this drawdown of price. A bar that sets a new best never closes, as in LEAN. It reads closes, not highs, so it gives back from the best close. Which exits and halts a unit may use, and their numbers, are the risk session's call (ledger R-04); this entry says what the rule does, not whether to use it. QML's unit runtime does not yet pass an exit its position, so inside a unit this exit stays silent until it does. One instance serves one position at a time on its side, and the entry price names the position: an entry price other than the one it holds starts a new position with fresh state. Two positions back to back at the very same entry price would share state until the runtime names each position.
recognition: The trade is closed when it falls back a set share from the best it reached.

class_meanings.perp: freqtrade scales a futures trade's profit ratio by its leverage; this ratio is the price's, before leverage.
class_meanings.index_cfd: a gap across the close moves past the level between two bars; the exit reads the next bar.
